environment: Node test runner, python3, scratch git repos from the cli-runner with a scratch HOME; no network

cases.title: ste-check.py passes the three edited prompts and the env-detector rule sits in step 4
cases.given: The edited env-detector.md, slicer.md and state-schema.md
cases.when: Run ste-check.py on them; read the step order and the Inputs line
cases.then: Exit 0 with no output; the exact R-064 sentence appears once in step 4; steps 5 to 8 follow in order; no step citation breaks
cases.expected: Exit 0 with no output; the exact R-064 sentence appears once in step 4; steps 5 to 8 follow in order; no step citation breaks
cases.actual: Exit 0, empty stdout. The sentence appears once in step 4. Steps 4 to 8 are in order. No prompt or test cites an env-detector step number. A copy with one added banned word makes ste-check exit 1, and a missing path exits 1 with 'unreadable'.

evidence.title: ste-check.py run
evidence.inline:
$ python3 skills/sdlc/ste-check.py prompts/env-detector.md prompts/slicer.md prompts/state-schema.md
(no output)
exit 0

cases.title: A repo with no branchFormat names the slice branch through the default sdlc/{name}
cases.given: Repos with no config, a config without the field, branchFormat empty string and null
cases.then: Exit 0, format sdlc/{name}, branch sdlc/S-001 for each; a set format feature/{name} wins
cases.expected: Exit 0, format sdlc/{name}, branch sdlc/S-001 for each; a set format feature/{name} wins
cases.actual: All four cases print format sdlc/{name} and branch sdlc/S-001 with exit 0. The set format gives feature/S-001. The load_format property run (seed 268470099, 100 runs) had 0 violations. An unparseable config exits 2 with a clear error.

evidence.title: branches.py name on a repo with no config

cases.title: No script reads a slice's branch field (38 variants)
cases.given: A ledger of 3 slices and a git repo, with valid state
cases.when: Run next-action.py, state-write.py status, base-branch and patch-slice, and janitor.py with the branch field removed, null, number, bool, list, object, empty, newline, traversal, huge (2 MB), flag-like, and 24 attack-corpus values (2 per family)
cases.then: Every output, STATUS.md and the resulting slices.json equal the original run apart from branch and commit hash
cases.expected: Every output, STATUS.md and the resulting slices.json equal the original run apart from branch and commit hash
cases.actual: All 38 variants equal the original. next-action.py reports action 'slice' for S-002, so slice logic ran. A planted read of s.get('branch') in a copy of next-action.py made 3 of 3 sampled variants fail, so the test can fail.
cases.specSource: R-061 acceptance (no script reads the field)
